Read a FASTQ formatted file

Source: R/read_fastq.R
read_fastq.Rd

Read a FASTQ formatted file

Usage

read_fastq(fastq, path = NULL, format = "illumina1.8+")

Arguments

fastq

string, containing the FASTQ file name. Accepts compressed .gz files as well.

path

string, optional path to FASTQ file.

format

string, containing the FASTQ format. Options include: illumina1.8+, solexa, sanger. Default = illumina1.8+.

Value

A data.frame containing the FASTQ sequence data

Examples


fastq_data <- strollur::read_fastq(strollur_example("tiny.fastq.gz"))

# fastq_data is a data.frame.
# To access the names of the sequences in the file, run the following:

fastq_data$sequence_name
#> [1] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18327:1699"
#> [2] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:14069:1827"
#> [3] "M00967:43:000000000-A3JHG:1:1101:18044:1900"

# To access the sequences in the file, run the following:

fastq_data$sequence
